description: This is a shell test script for verifying the behavior of git repository selection logic, particularly in ambiguous cases involving local worktrees and bare repositories, and the automatic handling of the .git suffix.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the environment by removing temporary directories used during testing.

methods.name: make_tree
methods.description: Initializes a new git repository as a working tree and makes an initial commit.

methods.name: make_bare
methods.description: Creates a bare git repository with an initial commit.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Clones a git repository, fetching from a specified source.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Verifies that the fetched and cloned repositories have the expected latest commit message.
